description: Source code implementing ASN.1 UTCTime handling functions for OpenSSL, including conversion, setting, comparison, and validation.

methods.name: asn1_utctime_to_tm
methods.description: Converts ASN1_UTCTIME to struct tm, with optional timezone offset allowance.

methods.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_check
methods.description: Checks if ASN1_UTCTIME is valid by attempting conversion.

methods.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_set_string
methods.description: Sets ASN1_UTCTIME from a string representation.

methods.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_set
methods.description: Creates or updates ASN1_UTCTIME from a POSIX timestamp.

methods.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_adj
methods.description: Adjusts ASN1_UTCTIME based on POSIX timestamp with optional day and second offsets.

methods.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_cmp_time_t
methods.description: Compares ASN1_UTCTIME with a POSIX timestamp.
